name: MAKcubes | No Revisions & Purge
author: Mohammed Kassem

sections.description:
Arabic:
إضافة من تطوير MAKcubes. حقوق النشر محفوظة لـ Mohammed Kassem | MAKcubes. مرخّصة بـ GPLv2 أو أحدث.
يسمح بالاستخدام والتعديل وإعادة التوزيع وفق شروط الرخصة، مع الحفاظ على الإسناد وعدم استخدام العلامات التجارية بشكل مضلل.

English:
A WordPress plugin by MAKcubes. Copyright © 2025 Mohammed Kassem | MAKcubes. Licensed under GPLv2 or later.
You may use, modify, and redistribute under the GPL terms with proper attribution. MAKcubes trademarks
are not covered by GPL; do not imply endorsement without permission.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings from the plugin page if available.
sections.faq:
Can I modify the plugin?

Yes, under GPLv2 or later. Keep author credits and include GPL license when redistributing.

Can I use MAKcubes logos?

No. Trademarks are not part of the GPL grant. Written permission is required for brand usage implying endorsement.

short_description: Automatically delete all existing post revisions and optionally prevent new ones from being created in WordPress.
